MSQ to 1400 and beyond (Skip Tier 1 Dungeons)
- 100% Regional Quests in YOUR faction AND Enemy Faction   (Wisdom, Daeva Crystals, Gear, Clash Runes)
- 100% "?" Sealed Dungeons, Strongholds in YOUR faction (Wisdom, Daeva Crystals, materials, and belt enhancement scrolls)
- Enemy Faction Strongholds/Mystery Dungeons (Enhance Stones, Kina, Abyss points)
- Monolith to level 30 for enhancement scrolls and mats  (Extra feathers convert with substance morph to power shards)

- Abyss Feathers (All) for 36 PVP Azphel tiles (counts toward PVE CP)

- +10 Hone Bracelet, Weapon, and Guard AFTER you finish story quest + regionals
- Enhance Amulet and Belt to Unique (Enhance to +10 and substance morph after equipping it)
- +5 on all pieces of other gear (Minus Belt/Amulet)
- Clash Runes (Tap to +1 100% chance, use EXTRAS to tap higher and equip the highest while only enhancing ones you do not have equipped)
- ManaStone/Soulstone 1 time on each piece with lowest quality stones.

Pet Genus, tap it to the next level then send a couple to change passive lines (Don’t lock until near max)  Goal is 9 Special (last one) First, roll line 4 until you hit double chance/damage% and then lock it (Heroic, unique is okay to settle on until later)  then go top down leveling them equally with the same strategy.

1400-1600
Expeditions  (Why Armor Dungeon)
 Vakron Exploration, Claim 3x For first pity box (If you’re a sub you can adjust total claims)
 Vakron Conquest, Farm 21-42 times for gear drops  (Pity Guard if possible or Craft it, max yield is swap to gugu)
Hone these pieces evenly to +10 as you get them

1600 Transcendence (Odyle energy) Do Each 1 1-2 times to get a card in every slot (+100 GS)

1700+
Out of Odyle energy?  Craft (Jewelry and work on crafted BIS weapon)
Have Energy?
Run Urugugu Canyon and Pity Weapon while getting jewelry slots filled
Hone these pieces evenly to +10 as you get them

1900 Transcendence (Odyle energy) can try for more green/blue cards  (Got 3 greens in my first run for +80 CP)

Pet Genus - Tap lines to reach new levels, don’t worry about locking until you’re on the last near last level, free power.

Health on hard mode 360,000,000

10 * 60 = 600 seconds  10 minute enrage
8  * 60 = 480 seconds   8 minute prediction with 2 minute downtime

342,342,000 / 600 = 570,570  (10 Minute)

342,342,000 / 480 = 713,212 (8 Minute)

570,570 / 10 = 57,057 (10 Minute all players)

713,212 / 10 = 71,312 (8 minutes all players)
713,212 /  8 = 89,151 (68players (-2 clerics for “Carry” 0))

Normal Mode 190,000,000

190,000,000 / 600 = 316,666 (10 Min)
190,000,000 / 480 = 395,833 (8 Min)

316,666 / 10 = 31,666 (8 Minutes all players)
395,833 /   8 = 49,479 ( 8 Minutes 8 players (Factoring clerics at 0))

Why Explosive Arrow over Griffon Early Game?
They do the same damage early, but you can reduce the cooldown of explosive arrow by 15s at rank 1. We swap to Griffon at 15 which has dot damage which helps proc other effects.

You can clear the first 10 levels of the far left bosses (First column and spend on Daevanion crystals and stigma shards.  After that you should hold for the statue after Zikel.

Macro Setup
   1. Setup your Skills vertically like below
   1. While leveling, just add what you have as you go
   2. AUTOMATIC/LAZY
   3.      4. SELF BUFF
   5.         1. More damage with efficient usage (plan around boss dying soon/next boss)
      2. We also stack Trap + Arrow in priority order for use
      6.       2. Set up your Macro by clicking THE MACRO button in the top right of your skills
      1.
      2. Click each skill and select the horizontal (main row) skill
      3. AUTOMATIC/LAZY LEVELING
      4.         5. MANUAL (MORE DAMAGE)
         1. (Testing new macro setup, 2vigor/3magic minor mana problems if you have short fast targets)
         6.               3. Enter your settings and bind the macro key
            1.

Rotation
               1. Hold left and right click
               2. Marking Shot
               1. Marking shot lasts longer than the cooldown so make sure to wait until it’s at 1 second before recasting. (Especially with Vaizels 20)
               2. Marking shot has a movement component if you’re actively holding a direction, use it for a stamina free move.
               3. Self Buff necessary for damage windows or automate with macro
               4. Manually Cast Deadshot (Hold until Max)

1+2 are also used for PVP/PVE grinding.
You can move the buffs (Supporting fire, Vaizels, and Guardian out of your macro for more control of your damage and burst in later content)
Swap Griffon and Explosive in your macro depending on your stigma.

Why do you have drill dart/tempest twice?
At level 16 you can have two charges of it, it is also tied to your mana “dump” tempest shot which will use itself twice through the cycle of the macro 1234.

Left image is with double drill dart, 3 stack macro.
Right is with 2 macro simplified.

Skills
Some skill and stigma loadouts will have different results based on your stat breakpoints, always test your build before and after!

For which skill to level use the priorities listed below.

Ice Chain is used early to mid game in your macro for a DPS increase until you reach 16 on a few skills AND CDR/CS breakpoints.  You can also put this in your macro for better AOE/Leveling early game.  It can still be a DPS increase even after reaching the breakpoints.  TEST YOUR SKILLS!
               * Wish
               * Hellfire
               * Blaze
               * Flame Arrow

After some testing (samples below) Blaze 16, Flame 16, Wish 16 is where I found the breakpoint with 8.8% CDR to where I could take Ice Chain out, but since it is break even or slightly ahead I’m leaving it in for now for better farming and corridors.

Blaze For now, do not push for +20 we stop at +16 for CDR.

Flame Scattershot can be used for heal (level 8) OR pushed to 16 in edge case scenarios for CDR.  You will most likely be point starved and unable to do this.
